findings.mechanism: Each call creates a new HTTPS connection without reuse, incurring DNS, TCP, TLS round trips. This matches 01-what-a-connection-actually-costs. No timeout also violates 03-timeouts-as-a-first-principle.
findings.remediation: Create a single persistent HTTP client with keep-alive (e.g., use undici's Pool) and set a request timeout (e.g., 5s) instead of calling fetch directly per request.
findings.arithmetic: Cold connection cost = 4 * RTT. Assuming RTT=30ms (typical intra‑datacenter), added latency = 4*30 = 120 ms per request. Baseline warm request ≈ RTT = 30 ms, so p99 increase ≈ 120 ms.

prediction.condition: no client reuse, each request creates a new connection
